narrative.overview: The clothing rail remains the hero. Refine the existing white/cream RACK identity into a quieter fashion studio; the garments supply the depth, material and color.
keyCharacteristics: Actual sculpted garments, calm colorways and distinct cloth/leather finishes.
Mixed-case typography with a lighter visual rhythm.
White and cream surfaces with restrained capsule controls.
Interactive 3D throughout the rail, collection edit, close view and open menus.

rules.name: The Material Rule
rules.body: Change only allowlisted clothing materials on a cloned assembly. Replace their printed diffuse map with the chosen solid color and tuned roughness; preserve sculpted folds, normal/AO maps, UVs, geometry, source textures and untouched hardware.

dos: Do let the real garments provide the visual detail.
Do keep thumbnail, color name, selected state and 3D material consistent.
Do use the existing source meshes, hanger fits and performance safeguards.
Do preserve keyboard, reduced-motion and phone layouts.
donts: Don't add a walkable store or replace the rail hero.
Don't recolor source texture files or mutate shared loader materials.
Don't reintroduce heavy text shadows, beveled UI or decorative words behind clothing.
